title: Mississippi law school is among first in nation to require AI education
body: Mississippi College School of Law is making AI education mandatory for all students to address its growing influence in jurisprudence.

title: Apple may have dropped big AI Siri hint ahead of WWDC 2026
body: Apple may have given us the first glimpse of a new Siri set to be unveiled later this year. As per a report, Apple's teaser for WWDC 2026 hinted at a new glow effect for its virtual assistant.

title: Why Marvell Stock Is Surging Today
body: Marvell is getting a valuation boost thanks to a recent report suggesting that Alphabet is contracting with the company for two new chip designs. As of this writing, Marvell stock is now up roughly 75% this year.

title: Trump to read Bible verses as part of week-long faith event
body: President Donald Trump will read a piece of Old Testament scripture during the week-long America Reads the Bible event.

title: How AI is becoming a 'game changer' for RI's health care systems
body: Electronic record keeping is the bane of many a doctor. It's onerous and leads to physician burnout. Could AI help fix this problem?
